Home.aboutHeading: About Dura Plast: Skylight and Roof Ventilation Manufacturer
about: Dura Plast is a skylight and roof ventilation design and development company, established in **2010**. We harness sunlight and wind to naturally light and ventilate buildings, using polycarbonate skylights, glazing sheets and roof ventilation systems under our **RHINO TUFF** brand.

From concept and design to development, delivery and fitment, we provide **tailor-made, turn-key and cost-effective** skylighting and roof ventilation solutions for the global building and construction industry.

solutions.heading: World Class Skylighting & Natural Ventilation Solutions
solutions.subheading: RHINO TUFF products are engineered for the natural lighting and ventilation needs of buildings that are meant to be green, energy efficient, safe and reliable.

categoryDescriptions.Skylighting and Glazing: Polycarbonate flat, corrugated and multiwall sheets, dome skylights, barrel vaults, thermal insulated skylights, plexiglass domes and tubular skylights.
categoryDescriptions.Roof Ventilation: Wind driven turbine ventilators and hybrid ventilators for natural air movement.
categoryDescriptions.Specialized Industrial Roofing: FRP roof sheets and FRP rain water gutters.
categoryDescriptions.Roof Curbs: FRP roof curbs and transparent polycarbonate roof curbs for mounting skylights and ventilators.
categoryDescriptions.Light and Air: Polycarbonate louvers and skylight dome or tubular skylight combos with turbine ventilators.

whyUs.heading: Innovation, Technology and Performance in Every Roof
whyUs.subheading: Our skylights and ventilators are designed to reduce dependence on artificial lighting and mechanical ventilation, so buildings stay brighter, fresher and more comfortable with natural light and air.

projects.heading: Skylight Projects Across Industries and Countries
projects.subheading: Dura Plast skylights and ventilation systems are used in hotels, airports, museums, sports courts, schools and commercial and industrial buildings.

faq.a: Dura Plast designs, manufactures and exports polycarbonate skylights, glazing panels and roof ventilation systems that bring natural light and air to buildings.
RHINO TUFF is the Dura Plast product range. It covers polycarbonate sheets, dome and barrel vault skylights, tubular skylights, roof ventilators, roof curbs, FRP roof sheets and FRP gutters.

faq.q: Which product categories does Dura Plast offer?
faq.a: Skylighting and Glazing, Roof Ventilation, Light and Air combos, Roof Curbs, and Specialized Industrial Roofing.

faq.q: Does Dura Plast export outside India?
faq.a: Yes. Dura Plast exports its skylights, glazing panels and ventilation systems to buildings worldwide.

faq.q: How do I get a quote or become a distributor?
faq.a: Send your requirements through the Request a Quote form, or use the Become a Distributor and Contact Us options on the website. You can also email sales@duraplastindia.com.
